# Mabel Colby

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c36 P21](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0021), [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v3 c9 P7](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0007)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolteacher  <sub>[v3 c9 P7](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0007), [v3 c9 P8](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0008)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** The "rose-red" girl  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>

## Appearance

Mabel is a dark-eyed and striking young woman. She won the beauty prize among the Second Year classes at the Academy.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006)_

## Personality

Mabel possesses a heart brimming with bright, imaginative, and longing dreams similar to those of Nell. Although she expresses fatigue over the relentless demands of rural teaching and writes passionately about its trials, she maintains a sense of humor and warmth toward her friends.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v3 c9 P8](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0008), [v3 c9 P9](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0009), [v3 c9 P11](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0011), [v3 c9 P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013)_

## Traits

- Striking  <sub>[v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)</sub>

## Goals

- To attend college at Wexcombe and join the Sophomore class  <sub>[v1 c36 P23](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0023), [v3 c9 P8](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0008), [v3 c9 P11](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0011)</sub>
- To rent a small home in Portmaris with Nell and Honora under the care of Aunt Euphemia  <sub>[v3 c9 P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013)</sub>
- To write a realistic paper titled 'The Trials of a Country Schoolmarm'  <sub>[v3 c9 P8](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0008)</sub>

## History

Mabel Colby studied at Regent's Academy, where she was considered the most beautiful girl in the Second Year classes and formed a close circle of friends with Nell Harcourt and Honora Hollis. Following her third year at Regent's, she worked as a country schoolteacher for two years, managing a wide range of grade levels and dealing with demanding parents. Tired of rural teaching and the fatigue of boarding, Mabel decided to pursue a degree at Wexcombe College by joining the Sophomore class. She proposed a co-living arrangement to Nell and Honora, suggesting they rent and keep house together in Portmaris with her Aunt Euphemia acting as housekeeper. Later, she lived in Portmaris alongside her friends, dealing with domestic antics such as their resident cats, Smudge, Joseph, and the Sarah-cat.

_Sources: [v1 c35 P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v3 c9 P7](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0007), [v3 c9 P8](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0008), [v3 c9 P11](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0011), [v3 c9 P12](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0012), [v3 c9 P13](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0013), [v3 c16 P59](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0059), [v3 c16 P60](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0060), [v3 c16 P63](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0063), [v3 c16 P70](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0070)_
